snippets.title: Superagent AI launches autonomous platform for agencies
snippets.snippet: SUPERAGENT AI, a provider of AI-driven solutions for insurance agencies, has launched a new platform designed to function as a unified autonomous workforce, streamlining communication, quoting and customer engagement. ... The offering, known as SUPERAGENT 2.0, marks a shift from standalone AI tools to a fully integrated environment where agencies can manage core workflows within a single system, reducing reliance on multiple tools and legacy infrastructure. ... SUPERAGENT AI develops software that combines voice, email, quoting and training tools into one platform, helping agencies automate processes and improve productivity. The latest version expands these capabilities into a more cohesive system aimed at independent agencies. ... 2.0 ... “With SUPERAGENT 2.0, we are shifting from providing a standalone AI tool to delivering a complete, autonomous workforce platform. Agencies no longer need to bolt AI onto legacy systems. They can now provision compliant phone numbers, warm email domains, and deploy autonomous quoting within a single, unified environment.” SUPERAGENT AI CEO Vlada Lotkina said.
